subject: reasoning
question:
Select the triad which follows the same pattern as that followed by the two triads given below. Both triads follow the same pattern.

UM - SK - PR

RJ - PH - MO
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7c3147b7d7f0ab6e52de9863fca7fb6a9e39d47b0e4c217b7c99829ad65dc95.png] 

Logic followed here is:

The positional values of the first letters in each pair of the triad decrease by 2 then 3, while the positional values of the second letters decrease by 2 then increase by 7.

**UM - SK - PR →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/982451160c6b622d66fa47a059887049e7f7b439d6cb221f8e33ea19161fa732.png] 

 

**RJ - PH - MO →**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e88b47bc6fbdf63b2c32a88e0f870ac2412490ed5ee4d24a1b2d1a776f7c0fc0.png] 

 

**Similarly, **

**Option 4) NF - LD - IK:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/58daa5e0b32076dd91e4ae580054529308216a3aeb4e2d3c8c049e9fd727fb3f.png] 

Therefore, the triad that follows the same pattern is 'NF - LD - IK'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
